entry.title: The Golden Age of Portal Games
entry.content:
Everyone my age remembers the first portal site that felt like it was made for us. A grid of tiny thumbnails, a marquee of new games, and the particular electricity of a game that loaded in four seconds and asked for nothing.

What made it work

It was the friction. There was none. No account, no download, no "play for 30 seconds then pay". You clicked and you played. That contract — free, instant, complete — is the thing every browser game site since has spent a decade violating.

The best game portal was the one that got out of your way.

I still keep this picture from the LAN room where I learned to save hi-scores properly.

entry.title: Best Free Puzzle Games of Summer 2024
entry.content:
Summer hits and the puzzle shelf gets a refresh. Three of my favourites from the season, all free, all playable in a browser tab:

  • Gravity tangle — one button, endless slingshots. The rules take ten seconds and the mastery takes hours.
  • Light path — mirror rotation with a dash of physics. Deceptively hard in the final act.
  • Tile storm — match-three at speed, with a twist that makes the third row matter.

entry.title: How to Beat Level 5 in Asteroids
entry.content:
Level 5 is where Asteroids stops being an introduction and starts being an exam. Here is the whole secret, and it is smaller than you think.

The split shot

When an asteroid cracks, the two halves diverge on a predictable arc. Fire before the split, aimed at the point where the halves will be — not where they are. One shot, two kills, and a few precious seconds of empty screen.

Thrust discipline

The number one killer on level 5 is momentum you do not need. Tap the engine in pulses of two frames. If your ship is drifting when you turn, you are already one asteroid away from a restart.

Practice this until the split shot is boring, and level 5 stops being a wall and becomes a doorway.

entry.title: About this blog
entry.content:
This blog started in January 2024 as a place to write about free browser games — the good ones, the strange ones, and the ones worth your afternoon. No ads in the way, no sign-up walls, just games and the writing around them.

If you find a game that deserves a post, write in through the comment form. I read everything.
